review_improvement: Preserves all named ports and five-cycle semantics while isolating the management-path ambiguity and preventing self-disconnection.
independent_technical_reasoning: Host `ip link` controls a Linux netdev, but a BMC sideband or dedicated port may not map to that namespace at all. A shared physical NIC can also carry both host and management paths. Therefore the source cannot be executed safely from port labels alone: engineering must bind every physical port to a controllable target or a monitor role and prove the recovery channel is topologically independent.
